info.name: UBS — Full Integrity Test Suite (SRS)
info.description:
Import **UBS-Local.postman_environment.json** (only baseUrl).

**Run order:** 00 Setup → 01 E2E → role folders → 99 Validation → 98 Security

**OTP:** After signup, copy OTP from app console → set collection var `otpCode` → run Verify OTP.

**Seed passwords:** admin uses Admin@123; operator/finance use Password@123

SRS: User = Customer. Use `userId` / `customerUserId`, not customerId.
